instruction: Wash your hands with soap and water, then put on clean gloves. Gently remove the old dressing. If it sticks, soak it with clean water before lifting it. Rinse the burn with cool running water, then pat the skin dry with a clean towel. Do not rub the burn and do not break any blisters. Use a cotton swab to apply a thin layer of burn ointment to the burn. Cover the burn with a non-stick pad, then wrap it loosely with a gauze roll. Secure the gauze with medical tape, keeping the tape off the burned skin. Call your nurse if the burn becomes more red or swollen, starts to smell or leak pus, or if you develop a fever.
